metadata.title: Dataset and Code: A Data-Driven Decision Support Framework for Hospital Pharmacy Med- ication Supply under Demand Uncertainty
metadata.description:
This repository contains the anonymized dataset, reproducible code, simulation scripts, and manuscript-ready outputs associated with the study “A Data-Driven Decision Support Framework for Hospital Pharmacy Medication Supply under Demand Uncertainty: Empirical Evidence and Simulation-Based Decision Rules”.

The study evaluates probabilistic demand models for hospital pharmacy medication supply using empirical demand and cost data from 13 anonymized medicines observed over 48 months. The empirical analysis includes demand-profile characterization, distributional fitting, one-cycle stochastic inventory-cost evaluation, and comparison between observed and model-based replenishment decisions. Candidate demand models include the normal, gamma, negative binomial type II, and zero-inflated negative binomial distributions.

The repository also includes a Monte Carlo simulation study designed to assess the robustness of model-selection patterns under controlled combinations of demand level, demand variability, zero-demand frequency, temporal trend, and shortage-cost exposure. The simulation outputs are used to derive interpretable decision rules for selecting probabilistic inventory models in hospital pharmacy replenishment decisions.

All medication identifiers have been anonymized as M01–M13. The repository includes processed data, published result tables, recomputation scripts, simulation scripts, generated figures, LaTeX tables, and reproducibility checks. The code is organized so that users can reproduce the empirical calculations, regenerate the simulation study, recreate manuscript-ready outputs, and compare recomputed results against the published outputs.

This material is intended to support transparency, reproducibility, and reuse of the analytical workflow underlying the associated manuscript.
